Extract parameters from models, templates, or representations

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-prior.R, R/S7-methods.R, and 1 more
get_parameters.Rd

Extract parameters, parameter names, or priors from objects

Usage

get_parameters(x, space = c("original", "transformed"), ...)

get_stan_priors(x, space = c("original", "transformed"), ...)

get_parameter_names(x, original_pars = FALSE, ...)

get_expected_mu(x, ...)

get_expected_sigma(x, ...)

get_marginal_mu(x, ...)

get_marginal_sigma(x, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Prior>
get_stan_priors(x, space = c("original", "transformed"), ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Object>
get_parameters(x, space = c("original", "transformed"), ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Object>
get_stan_priors(x, space = c("original", "transformed"), ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
get_parameter_names(x, original_pars = FALSE, ...)

## S7 method for class <any>
get_parameter_names(x, original_pars = FALSE, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_expected_mu(x, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_expected_sigma(x, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_marginal_mu(x, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_marginal_sigma(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A category representation, template, cognitive model, stanfit, or prior object.

space

Character string indicating which parameter space to return: "original" (default) or "transformed".

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

original_pars

Logical scalar; if TRUE, return original (unmapped / top-level) Stan model parameter names from the underlying Stan program (as stored in stanfit@model_pars) rather than the expanded, indexed, and post-processed/renamed parameter draw names (as returned by names(stanfit)). Default: FALSE.

Value

A list, vector, matrix, data frame, or MVBU_Prior object.

See also

parameter_prior, get_data

Examples

mod <- example_mvg_ideal_observer(n_cues = 2)
get_parameters(mod)
